title: The US CFTC says a district court judge granted its request for a temporary restraining order barring Arizona from continuing its criminal case against Kalshi (Jack Queen/Reuters)
summary: Jack Queen / Reuters: The US CFTC says a district court judge granted its request for a temporary restraining order barring Arizona from continuing its criminal case against Kalshi — A federal judge on Friday blocked Arizona from continuing its criminal case against prediction market Kalshi …
